goal: Keep in-memory key state and disk state synchronized when wallet database writes or commits fail
Prevent node crashes and leftover plaintext keys on disk during failed encryption or passphrase changes
Allow users and RPC callers to distinguish between bad passphrases and database write errors
reviewability: Ready to review now; the rebase is mechanical
agreement: Strong substantive support with all prior objections settled
Verified by testing encryption write-failure and RPC failure paths (vicjuma)
Verified by building and running tests (jeanpablojp)
Addressed concerns regarding rollback complexity and key erasure safety (achow101, w0xlt)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because failed encryption commits could crash the node or leave plaintext keys un-erased on disk
Prevents locked and unlocked states from desynchronizing when passphrase changes fail
